sampling_dimensions.sampling_space_description: A representative, approximately weighted sampling space for U.S.-resident parents of at least one child aged 4 or 5 who enjoy reading books. The proportions below are provisional estimates for population diversity, not exact measurements of this specific subgroup; they are marginal proportions and should not be treated as a joint distribution. A real representative sample should calibrate them against a current, population-specific survey or sampling frame. Every reading-preference profile is compatible with enjoying books, although frequency, access, and available time vary.
